versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00306, SRS_Rte_00300, SRS_Rte_00301 The RTE Implementation Plug-In shall determine the <rips_return_ref> type applicable for global copy according to [SWS_Rte_80041]. Thereby the <rips_return_ref> type is a pointer to the type of the global copy (by the means of foo * where foo is the type of the global copy ).
